items.title: GPU memory near capacity
items.explanation: GPU memory has been above 90% for 45s, currently 92.9%. For a workload with a preallocated KV cache this is often by design — check whether the number moves at all before treating it as a leak.
items.suggested_action: If the figure is static it is the runtime's own reservation and is expected. If it climbs, look for another process sharing the device, or a growing set of loaded adapters or models.

items.title: Time to first token dominated by queueing
items.explanation: p95 TTFT is 904ms against a 500ms target, and about 87% of it (788ms) is queue time before the scheduler admits the request. Prefill accounts for roughly the remaining 117ms, so tuning prompt handling would barely move the number a user sees.
items.suggested_action: Add serving capacity, or admit requests sooner by raising the concurrency limit if the GPU has headroom. Routing long prompts to a separate pool also helps, because they are what holds admission slots open.
